ValidationRule.description: R-EAP2: an appointment falls inside its event, from the event's start to its end.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Start__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End__c)), OR( Start__c < Event__r.Start__c, End__c > Event__r.End__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The appointment must start and end within the event's own Start and End.
